row.evidence: Okta's catalogue says StackAdapt's integration lets customers sign in with Okta and "automatically provision users through the SCIM protocol", but StackAdapt publishes no prices ("Specific pricing is not published publicly") and its help centre is not publicly reachable.
row.notes: New row. Quote-only: plans are Basic (self-serve), Grow, Scale, Accelerate and Enterprise with no published prices or feature rows for SSO or SCIM. SCIM is evidenced only by the Okta OIN listing (OIDC SSO plus SCIM create/update/deactivate), so status stays unknown under rule 6a rather than gated. StackAdapt's help centre (support.stackadapt.com) returns a Cloudflare challenge to every fetch, so any vendor SCIM guide could not be read. The public REST/GraphQL API covers campaigns and reporting; user management is not documented publicly.

plans.name: Enterprise
plans.price_text: Not published; custom partnership, request a demo

scim.notes: StackAdapt's own SCIM documentation, if any, is in its help centre, which is behind a Cloudflare challenge. The only public SCIM evidence is the Okta OIN listing (SCIM create, update, deactivate), recorded under idp_apps; per the rules an IdP listing alone does not back scim.available.

auth.notes: API keys are issued by StackAdapt on request.

rate_limits.text: All APIs are rate-limited; exceeding the limit returns HTTP 429.

user_api.notes: StackAdapt publishes REST, GraphQL and Pixel APIs for campaigns, assets and reporting (api_key in X-AUTHORIZATION or Bearer token). The GraphQL schema is only visible with a token, so no public user-management operations could be confirmed.

okta.notes: OIN listing ticks OIDC, SCIM, Create, Update and Deactivate (not Group Push, Attribute Sourcing or Sync Password). Last updated Jul. 22 2026. Who built the connector is not stated.

entra.notes: No Microsoft Learn tutorial found (stackadapt-tutorial and stackadapt-provisioning-tutorial return 404).

fallbacks.notes: The API reference is public, but the help centre (where any SCIM or SSO guide would live) sits behind a Cloudflare challenge and its search API requires authentication.
